entities.summary: Oleksandr Ksenofontov or Xenophontov is a Soviet Ukrainian record producer and lyricist. He is the husband of the winner of the Eurovision Song Contest 2004, Ruslana. Ksenofontov wrote the lyrics to the winning song, "Wild Dances". They have been married since 28 December 1995. He is also a lead singer of legendary Ukrainian rock group Tea Fan Club. Together with Ruslana, he is the owner of the Luxen Company.
